sentences.text: This review covers wellbore 15/9-F-14 on the Volve field in the Norwegian North Sea, written from general knowledge of the field without access to the well's daily reports or survey data.
No figures from the well's data are stated here, because none could be retrieved and checked for this draft.

The hole-section layout, hole sizes, casing shoe depths and section end depths for 15/9-F-14 should be taken from the well's final drilling summary and checked against the daily reports before the review is issued.
Each section's drilling performance, including new hole drilled and rate of penetration, should be compared with the planned profile once those values are confirmed.
Activity hours, interruption hours and the split of lost time by category and subcategory need to be computed from the coded activity log before any lost-time conclusion is drawn.
The main lost-time drivers, and whether they were primary or possible events, should be stated only once that breakdown is available.
The spud, section start and end, completion and campaign dates for 15/9-F-14 should be taken from the report index rather than recalled from memory.
The review is incomplete until the hole-section table, the lost-time breakdown and the timeline are populated and checked against the source data.
